item.title: Cost of Living in Essendon West Melbourne
item.description:

Is Essendon West Expensive?

Essendon West sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Essendon West, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.
